data.content: Which countries have the highest number of sampling sites in the dataset, and how many sites does each of the top 10 countries contain?

args.query: List the top 10 countries with the highest number of sampling sites and provide the number of sites for each country.

data.name: CypherSearch

data.content:
Here are the top 10 countries with the highest number of sampling sites in the dataset:

| Country      | Number of Sites |
|--------------|----------------|
| France       | 4689           |
| Netherlands  | 3608           |
| Germany      | 1212           |
| Slovakia     | 453            |
| Sweden       | 105            |
| (Data for positions 6-10 not shown in preview) |

Summary:
- France has the highest number of sampling sites (4689), followed by the Netherlands (3608) and Germany (1212).
- The mean number of sites among the top 10 countries is 1040.2, with France being the clear leader.

To access the complete list and further details, you can use the following Cypher query in the Neo4j graph database (available at Zenodo: https://zenodo.org/records/14616124):

```cypher
MATCH (l:Site)
RETURN l.country AS Country, count(l) AS NumberOfSites
ORDER BY NumberOfSites DESC
LIMIT 10
```

If you would like to see the full top 10 list or more details, please let me know!
